title: Statistical sampling
scope: Bounded snapshot sampling and PostgreSQL persisted bundles; not hot-tier eviction, daily aggregates, or an online reservoir.

requirements.formal-atomicity: Bounded publication, abort, restart, whole-bundle admission, exact-source isolation and post-selection filtering
requirements.allocation-parity: Versioned SHA256 priorities, deterministic strata/allocation and weights agree across JS and Go
requirements.frame-binding: Full-population frame identities survive filtering, projection and input replay
requirements.clock-validity: Recorded canonical clocks only; pending/expired evidence and incomplete frames cannot invent weights
requirements.input-budgets: Candidate/byte limits and cancellation fail closed without suppressing independent exact queries
requirements.owned-evidence: Owned observations inherit selected Run membership and frame bindings
requirements.sample-composition: Shipped query remains unweighted sample composition, not exact or population totals
requirements.activity-publication: Real Activity workflow publication, replay, corrections and recycle preserve the statistical source
requirements.native-browser: Native IndexedDB and a real data worker execute statistical queries, not synthesized source rows
requirements.sqlite-live-backfill: The same local HTTP app sees a refreshed canonical SQLite overlay frame without changing snapshot bytes
requirements.persisted-bundles: PostgreSQL preserves complete frozen bundles across restart, exact retention and incremental revisions
requirements.publication-rollback: Invalid or cancelled PostgreSQL publication preserves the committed frame

coverage.activity-publication: cao-activity publishes replay-safe daily counts and statistical queries through the Actions runtime

coverage.allocation-parity: shares framed SHA256 priorities and largest-remainder/failure-reserve golden membership with Go
coverage.frame-binding: binds weights to the entire eligible population, including unselected and zero-allocation candidates
coverage.clock-validity: never invents weights for incomplete frames, conflicting duplicates, invalid or missing timestamps
coverage.input-budgets: keeps exact queries available and skips oversized statistical-only stores
coverage.owned-evidence: keeps every owned observation of selected runs without sampling children independently
coverage.sample-composition: resolves sample composition through canonical ingestion and the production worker

suites.pattern: production data worker preserves statistical frames across filtering and canonical corrections$
